plugin.name: Image Preview
plugin.description: Image Preview is a free, open-source (MIT) Tavo plugin: preview and pin images over your chat, translate/define/search text without leaving the panel, and a small game corner for the wait between replies (a built-in jump game, Snake, Memory Bomb, plus games you add yourself). Everything here stays on your device by default; the built-in games are fully offline, games you add yourself run in an isolated box (only add ones you trust), and the only exception is Quick Lookup, which only ever sends the exact text you type and tap "Look up" on, and only then. No accounts, no subscriptions, and none planned. Built from one person's own needs, shared so others can use it, and open-sourced so it can outlive any one maintainer.

- Pins can be remembered per chat.

releaseNotes.2_3_3:
## Version 2.3.3

- Translate now tries three independent free engines (Google, Lingva, MyMemory) in order, so it keeps working even if one is down or rate-limited.
- Meaning now uses a real dictionary (definitions by part of speech) for English, and Wiktionary for Bengali, instead of raw Wikipedia search snippets.
- Web Search now merges Wikipedia summaries, Wiktionary, and DuckDuckGo, and always adds an 'Open full web search' result so you always reach real search results.
- Added an optional, free Brave Search API key (Settings only shown under Web Search) for full real web-search results instead of the limited fallback. The key is stored only on this device and sent only from it.
- The lookup status now shows which engine answered, so you know what you're reading.

releaseNotes.2_3_4:
## Version 2.3.4

- Fixed the pinned-image resize glitch (the grip jumping bigger/smaller unpredictably) — it was caused by two conflicting mobile touch systems fighting over the size at once; only one now handles it.
- Added real two-finger pinch-to-resize on the pinned image itself: spread your fingers to make it bigger, pinch in to shrink it, same as photo apps. The corner-grip drag-resize is still there too.
- Resizing (grip or pinch) now shows a small live 'XXXpx' size readout so you can see what you're dropping it at.
- Slightly enlarged the corner grip's touch target for easier grabbing with a fingertip.

releaseNotes.2_3_5:
## Version 2.3.5

- Fixed the Saved Previews delete button spilling outside the card — action buttons are now in a proper 2x2 grid sized to fit, and the card is a bit wider. Delete is also styled red so it's clearly distinct.
- "Import from device" is now a normal, always-visible button right under the URL field — no more needing to open a preview first to reach it.
- Added a Privacy Mode switch for Quick Lookup: when it's on, Translate/Meaning/Web Search refuse to contact the internet at all. When it's off (default), only the text you actually type and tap "Look up" on is ever sent anywhere — never your pins, saved images, or anything else. Everything else in this plugin (pins, saves, imports, drag/resize) has always stayed entirely on your device; this just makes it switchable and explicit for the one feature that talks to the internet.
- Long lookup text is now capped at 1000 characters before being sent, so a big accidental paste can't go out in one request.
runtime.gameHint: Tap or hold to jump (hold a little longer = jump higher). This game runs entirely on your device — nothing about it is ever sent anywhere.
releaseNotes.2_3_6:
## Version 2.3.6

- Added a small local mini-game (🎮 button, top of the panel) — a jump-over-obstacle runner you can play while waiting for a reply, since that wait can get boring. Tap or press Space to jump. Pick your own emoji as your character, and your best score is remembered.
- Fully local and offline: this game makes no network calls at all, nothing about it is ever sent anywhere — only your chosen emoji and best score are saved on this device.
releaseNotes.2_3_7:
## Version 2.3.7

- Fixed the laggy feeling — the game window was re-blurring the background 60 times a second, which is heavy on many phones. That blur is gone now.
- Difficulty ramps up much more gradually — the old version maxed out its speed in about 7 seconds; now it takes roughly 20.
- Added real hand control: hold the tap a little longer to jump higher, and a tap just slightly early near landing still counts instead of being wasted.
- Replaced the character emoji picker with a broader set (🏃👾⚡🐉💀), and the custom slot now accepts any emoji from your own keyboard, not just single simple ones.
- Added score-tier titles for fun, from 🥔 Potato Peasant up to 👑 True King, shown next to your best score and on the game-over screen.
- A note on the cross-player leaderboard idea: that would need a live server to collect everyone's scores, and would mean sending a name and score off your device to be visible to others — this plugin has no server and is built specifically so nothing leaves your device. Not something this format can do honestly. The tiered titles above are the local version of that idea — something to climb on your own.

releaseNotes.2_4_0:
## Version 2.4.0

A big one, mostly from player feedback:

- Renamed the plugin to "Image Preview" and added a new original icon.
- Title tiers are now much higher and harder to reach — True King now takes real effort instead of one good run — plus new, funnier low-score titles.
- Added silly, harmless one-liners when you die early, just for a laugh.
- Fixed the runner emoji facing backward.
- Added a mandatory player name before your first game, shown next to your title (e.g. "Potato Peasant IS Emon"). Tap your Best score to see the full title list.
- Added Reset run, Reset best score, and Change name — all separate, so resetting one never touches the others or any other plugin setting.
- Added a Relaxed Mode toggle: fixed gentle pace and a more forgiving hitbox, for anyone who wants the timing pressure off.
- The game window is now a real floating window: drag it by its header, resize it from the corner, and it remembers where you left it. It no longer looks or behaves like the pinned-image feature.
- Added Pause — stop mid-run to go read or send a roleplay message, then resume exactly where you left off. Your current run's progress (score/pace) is also saved so it survives closing the panel or switching chats, the same way your Best score already did — though exact obstacle positions can't be restored after a full reload, only score/progress.
- Quick Lookup now has an optional local search history — off by default, one tap to turn on, one tap to clear, entirely on your device like everything else here.
- Audited every delete/clear action in the plugin: they all genuinely erase the underlying saved data (not just hide it in the UI). One honest limit worth naming: no app, this one included, can control what happens to deleted data at the hardware/storage level after that — that's an OS and device question, the same for every app on your phone.

releaseNotes.2_5_0:
## Version 2.5.0

A compliance pass after reading Tavo's real plugin developer docs (thanks for sharing those):

- Declared the "network" and "variable" permissions in the manifest — this plugin makes web requests (Translate/Meaning/Web Search) and stores local settings/pins/scores, but neither permission was actually declared before. Confirmed "file" and "cover" were already correct.
- The floating button, and the game window's position/size, are now kept clear of Tavo's own top bar and message composer using the documented inset API, instead of just clamping to the raw screen edges. Previously a restored position could in theory land under Tavo's top bar, which the docs note is non-interactive for plugins — the button would look fine but not be tappable.
- Added a real recovery path for that: a new "Reset floating button position" setting. Turn it on, then off again, and the button returns to its default spot — even if it were ever stuck somewhere unreachable.
- Verified (no change needed): images imported from your device are saved as real files and referenced by a short path, never stored as huge inline data in plugin settings storage — this was already done correctly. Also verified the translation/language system already uses Tavo's own documented i18n API correctly, including re-rendering when you switch app language.
releaseNotes.2_6_0:
## Version 2.6.0

A real bug, found by reading the actual TavoJS variable docs (thank you for these too):

- Every tavo.set/tavo.get call in this plugin was missing its scope argument, which defaults to chat scope. That means your Brave Search key, game best score, player name, Relaxed Mode preference, Privacy Mode setting, search history, and floating-button position were all silently being saved per-chat, not device-wide — despite the game's v2.4.0 release notes explicitly promising your score/progress would carry across chats. That promise wasn't true. It's fixed now: all of those are explicitly saved with global scope, so they'll actually behave as described going forward.
- Pinned images stay chat-scoped on purpose — that one was already correct, and now says so explicitly in the code instead of relying on an unstated default.
- One-time side effect of this fix: because chat-scoped and global-scoped data are fully isolated from each other, the values saved under the old (accidental) chat scope won't automatically move to the new global scope. Your Brave key, best score, name, and button position will each reset once after this update, and then behave correctly (staying put, across every chat) from that point on.

releaseNotes.2_7_0:
## Version 2.7.0

- New: select any text on the chat page — a reply, your own message, anything — and a small "Look up" bubble appears near it. Tap it and the text goes straight into Quick Lookup's Search tab. No more opening a message's edit mode just to copy one word. Like everything else in Quick Lookup, this only fills the box — it still needs your own tap on "Look up" to actually send anything anywhere.
- Added a clear way to remove a custom character emoji from the mini-game and go back to the default, instead of only being able to switch to one of the presets.
- Found and fixed a real performance cost: the main panel used the same expensive background blur the game window used to have, and this panel scrolls (saved previews, lookup results), which made it worse. Removed, same as the earlier game-window fix.
- Cleaned up one leftover, unused settings-catalog entry.
- Updated the plugin description for the open-source release, and to reflect everything currently in the plugin.
- Audited the whole codebase for any subscription, payment, or billing code: there is none, and none is planned.
releaseNotes.2_7_1:
## Version 2.7.1

Removing a feature, not adding one — and being upfront about why:

v2.7.0's "select text anywhere and get a Look up bubble" doesn't actually work. Tested it live and confirmed: long-pressing a message shows Tavo's own native menu, and text selection there shows Android's native "process text" menu (Ask ChatGPT, Ask Claude, etc.) — neither ever reaches this plugin. Tavo's chat messages are very likely rendered as native UI, not as web content this plugin's HTML fragment can see or listen to. There's no documented plugin API for reading a selection out of the native chat UI, so this isn't fixable as built — it's removed instead of left in as dead, non-functional code (including a background listener that was doing nothing useful).

Everything else from v2.7.0 stays: the custom-emoji clear button, and the panel background-blur performance fix.
releaseNotes.2_8_0:
## Version 2.8.0

- Pinned images: the toolbar (zoom, reset, fullscreen, remove) can now be collapsed to a small handle so it doesn't sit over the image — tap the small arrow to hide or bring it back. Remembered per pinned image.
- Mini-game: the settings area (character picker, Relaxed Mode, Reset/Change name, hint text) is now collapsible via a small gear button next to your score, so the game window can stay small and clean while you play. Collapsed by default; your choice is remembered.

runtime.gameAiPrompt: Make me a small, mobile-friendly game as ONE single HTML file (HTML, CSS and JavaScript together in the same file). Rules: no external files, no internet, no images from URLs, and never use localStorage. It must fit a small window about 340px wide and 300px tall, work with touch only (tap or swipe, no keyboard needed), and use a dark background. To report the score, call parent.postMessage({emonGame:1,type:'score',score:NUMBER},'*') whenever the score changes, and parent.postMessage({emonGame:1,type:'gameover',score:NUMBER},'*') when the game ends (add low:true to both if a LOWER score is better). Give me only the complete code in one code block. The game idea:

releaseNotes.2_9_0:
## Version 2.9.0

- New: Game Library. Tap the game name at the top of the game window to pick a game.
- Two new built-in games: Snake (swipe to steer) and Memory Match.
- You can now add your own games. Paste the HTML code of a game (or import an .html file), give it a name and an emoji, and it appears in your library. Delete it any time.
- "Copy AI prompt" gives you a ready-made request to paste into any AI so it makes a compatible game for you.
- Added games run in an isolated sandbox: they cannot read your chats or Tavo data. Games can optionally report a score, and the window remembers a best score for each game.
- Fixed: typing a space in the game window's text boxes (like your name) no longer triggers a jump.

releaseNotes.2_10_0:
## Version 2.10.0

**Snake**
- Much slower and calmer by default, and now with three modes: Easy (slow, walls wrap around), Medium, and Extreme (fast, rocks keep appearing). Each mode keeps its own best score.
- Childhood-memory titles for your score (from "Kid Who Lost to the Wall" up to "The Kid Everyone Still Remembers"). Tap your Best score to see them all.
- New Points Store: every bite earns points. Spend them on snake skins, food (apple, donut, butterfly, gem...) and board looks. Bold, soft, or anything in between.

**Memory Bomb** (was Memory Match)
- A bomb timer, a target number of moves per level, and levels that keep getting harder.
- Tricks: from level 3, two hidden cards secretly swap places every few mistakes. If the timer runs out the cards are reshuffled once, then the bomb goes off.
- Fail and you get a funny, loving roast. Win and you collect a piece of wisdom into your own Wisdom library (tap the scroll).

**Under the hood**
- Built-in games now remember progress on your device.
- Your player name is shared across the Jump Game, Snake and Memory Bomb, and you can change it from the Games list.
- Game timers pause while the Games list is open.
runtime.gsWorld: The world is round: leave one edge and you appear on the opposite side. Mind your own tail.
releaseNotes.2_11_0:
## Version 2.11.0

**Snake**
- The world is round now, in every mode: go off the right edge and you come back from the left, off the top and you come back from the bottom. The only walls left are rocks (Extreme) and your own tail, which gets more dangerous the longer you grow.
- New horror-style titles, short and eerie, from "Cursed Hatchling" up to "Anaconda Eater" and beyond, all the way to "Ouroboros".
- Easy, Medium and Extreme moved into a new Settings panel (top corner), shown as a plain choice without emojis. The Points Store lives there too.
- New control setting: Swipe, or on-screen Arrow buttons (Left, Up, Down, Right) at the bottom.

**Memory Bomb**
- New emoji sets unlock as you climb: animals, food, sky and nature, objects, spooky things, and from level 11 a random mix of everything. The board never feels familiar for long.
